description: Expand/collapse header for the Assets and Debts sections in the Accounts card on the Finances (goals tab) screen. Tokenized replacement for the inline SectionHeader. Chevron + title + count badge + section total.

tokens.title: typography.smallBold / colors.text
tokens.countBadge: colors.glassMedium fill, radius.full, count typography.caption / colors.textMuted

accessibility.label: {title}, {count} accounts, total {total}. {Expanded|Collapsed}. Double tap to toggle.
